† [נָקַע] vb. be [severed, fig.] alienated, estranged (cf. Arabic نَقَعَ split, rend, sacrifice RSSem. i. 471 f.; 2d ed. 491; Ethiopic ነቅዐ split up, open (intrans.) Di647; NH נֶקַע cleft, Syriac ܢܶܩܥܳܐ id.);—
Qal Pf. 3 fs. נָֽקְעָה נַפְשִׁי מֵעַל Ez 23:18 my soul was estranged from her sister (‖ יָקַע), cf. v 22, 28 (both c. מִן).
